title: The house rules live in a tracked document
statement: The house rules MUST live in a tracked best-practice document that the code-style bundles include.
why: Rules in one person's memory never reach other people, CI or another person's build.

acceptance.text: Given the tracked house-rules document, when a style bundle is baked for a Node file, then the bundle includes the house rules.

falsifiedBy: A baked style bundle without the house rules after they are tracked.

sources.quote: The house-rules asymmetry is the most important thing any candidate found.
